name: Hoshoku Game 2 ~Sayounara. Marunomi~
original_name: 捕食ゲーム2～さようなら。丸呑み～
source:
A giant worm has escaped the science labs for a girl-swallowing rampage!
With each heroine it eats, it evolves its form. You are the worm!
Your goal: find and swallow the researcher who experimented on you!

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ089454.html/]DLsite English[/url]]
